# costgraph_virtual_tag (Resource)

Assign a virtual tag with ordered literal or inherited rules. The first active matching rule wins. This resource owns the key and its complete rules list. Requires explicit tenant-bound virtual-tags:write permission. Updates are atomic and stop if metadata or rules changed after refresh. Destroy removes the key and rules, retains source cost records, and refuses keys used by billing exports. Time-windowed and percentage rules are outside this resource's scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "tenant_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "UUID of the tenant authorized by the CostGraph API key."
}

resource "costgraph_virtual_tag" "team" {
  tenant_id   = var.tenant_id
  key         = "team"
  description = "Teams responsible for billing records"

  rules = [
    {
      rule_key   = "payments"
      scope      = "billing"
      expression = "bill.resource_name.startsWith(\"payments-\")"
      value      = "payments"
    },
    {
      rule_key       = "provider-owner"
      scope          = "billing"
      expression     = "\"owner\" in bill.tags"
      inherited_from = "bill.tags[\"owner\"]"
    },
    {
      rule_key   = "aws-fallback"
      scope      = "billing"
      expression = "bill.provider == \"aws\""
      value      = "platform"
      active     = false
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Virtual tag key. Changing it replaces the key. Existing keys must be imported rather than adopted during create.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Complete ordered rules list, at most 1000 entries. An empty list removes all rules and keeps the key. Reorder entries to change precedence. rule_key preserves each server rule UUID across edits and reorder. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID authorized by the API key. Changing it replaces the key. organization:manage does not grant virtual-tag access.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Key description. An empty value clears it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Virtual tag key UUID.
- `revision` (String) Opaque revision of metadata and rules used to prevent overwriting concurrent edits.
- `rules_revision` (Number) Server rules revision.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `expression` (String) CostQL condition evaluated against a billing record or Kubernetes resource.
- `rule_key` (String) Unique stable reference within this key. Keep it unchanged when editing or moving a rule. Imported legacy rules use their existing UUID as the reference.
- `scope` (String) CostQL scope, billing or k8s.

Optional:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the rule participates in matching. Set false to pause it without changing its identity.
- `inherited_from` (String) CostQL expression providing the inherited tag value. Set exactly one of value or inherited_from.
- `value` (String) Literal tag value. Set exactly one of value or inherited_from.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Stable server rule UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costgraph_virtual_tag.team '<tenant_uuid>/<key_uuid>'
```
